_comment: Example analyze job with a grading block (handoff 2026-07-29-lattice-grading-law). Run via the analyze subcommand on a fixed design; the certification's von Mises field is fed to the grading law and the report is written to run_info.json's grading object. Absent this block the run is byte-identical (bar L1). The certifiable band and cells-per-member floor are NOT job knobs — the law reads them from core.
